meta.title: Mage data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60 vs a level 63 training dummy): Arcane, Fire, Frost and the hybrid builds
meta.scope: Spell table and caster rules, every damage ability a level-60 mage uses against a raid boss, procs and personal debuffs, mana economy, the three talent trees in gunba's order with per-rank values, every mage build in gs, fs, MythicSim/Kami Labs and wow.gg (decoded and checked), priority lists, default stats, worked examples, and the engine gaps for the practice yard. Healing does not apply; Forever adds no mage tank build.
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path#Lline), a URL, or a list of them. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend. Spell rows cited as fs sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go are the beta client rows (build 1.60.1.70124) stored in foreversim. Wowhead Forever tooltips print scaling spells at the rank's maximum scaling level (Frostbolt 11 at 64: 470-506), so damage at 60 comes from the client rows: base + growth up to level 60.

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by Forever client data (spell rows, talent curves), a Wowhead Forever tooltip, Blizzard (development notes, the 7 Oct Mage and Shaman deep dive), or measured on the beta (mostly at levels 10-30).
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of one or both sims with no Forever source yet, or where sources disagree (including developer-style bug-tracker replies not flagged as Blizzard). Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the sims keep the Classic 1.12 / Classic Era value.

practiceYardSummary: Spell table vs +3: 17% miss, hit cap +16% (1% always misses); gear hit counts for spells and melee alike. Arcane Focus (+1%/point Arcane) and Elemental Precision (+1%/point Fire and Frost) are the talent hit. Frostbolt, Ice Lance, Cone of Cold, Frost Nova and Blast Wave are binary (no partial resists); other spells lose 6% on average to partial resists vs +3 (gs). No spell crit suppression in either sim.

Spell crit 1.5x; Ice Shards 5/5 makes Frost (and Frostfire Bolt) 2.0x, Arcane Mind 5/5 makes Arcane 2.0x (new). Base crit 0.2% + Int x 0.0168%. GCD 1.5 s, hasted by cast speed to a 1.0 s floor. No casting while moving; instants (Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Explosion, Cone of Cold) are the movement tools.

Arcane: Arcane Blast (talent, 2.5 s, 15% base mana +175% per stack) stacks +10% to your OTHER spells up to 4 times for 8 s; dump the stacks with Frostbolt at 3 stacks; Missile Barrage (40% from Arcane Blast, 20% from Fireball/Frostbolt/Frostfire Bolt, on landed hit) makes the next Arcane Missiles free and twice as fast (5 missiles in 2.5 s). Clearcasting 2%/point with a 1 s ICD.

Fire: Heating Up (1 Oct name of Hot Streak): non-periodic crits of Fireball/Frostfire Bolt/Fire Blast/Scorch each take 25% off the next Pyroblast (3 stacks = 1.5 s cast), 20 s, all stacks spent by that Pyroblast. Ignite 40% of the crit over 4 s in two ticks, per mage, rolling (no munching), never crits, no double dipping. Improved Scorch's Fire Vulnerability is personal: +3% of your own Fire damage per stack, 5 stacks, 30 s. Combustion: 3 crits.

Frost: Frostbolt spam (2.5 s with Improved Frostbolt). Winter's Chill is personal: +2% crit per stack on your Frostbolt and Ice Lance only, 5 stacks, 15 s. Fingers of Frost: each landed Chill (Frostbolt, Cone of Cold, Frostfire Bolt, Improved Blizzard) has 15% to give 2 charges that treat the boss as Frozen: Shatter +50% crit and Ice Lance x4 (Ice Lance SP coefficient unknown: gs .10, fs .143).

New baseline Frostfire Bolt (level 40): 3 s, 270-314 + 57 over 9 s, both Fire and Frost (lower resistance, higher spell damage), feeds Ignite, Ice Shards, Heating Up, Missile Barrage and Fingers of Frost. MythicSim lists a Frostfire hybrid (0/29/22) as experimental. Not in Forever: Molten Armor, Icy Veins, Dragon's Breath, Arcane Surge, Arcane Barrage, Water Elemental.

Mana: gs ranked builds spend ~5,000-7,700 mana/min and survive 300 s only with raid Judgement of Wisdom (~750-1,370/min), potions, runes and gems. Mage Armor (50%) and Arcane Meditation (50%) add up to 100% Spirit regen while casting in both sims. Offer a "raid Judgement of Wisdom" toggle.

None of the mage's debuffs are raid debuffs any more (Improved Scorch, Winter's Chill and Ignite are personal). The mage still provides Arcane Brilliance (+31 Int, 1 h). Forever Curse of the Elements covers all magic schools (+10%, -75 resistance).
meta.wowheadNote: Wowhead Forever talent tooltips print raw base points (Arcane Focus 2%, Elemental Precision 6%, Arcane Concentration 100%, Shatter 1%, Winter's Chill 0%). Ability tooltips match the client rows except that damage is printed at the rank's top scaling level (60-68), above the level-60 value.

arcane: Before the pull: Mage Armor, Arcane Intellect.
Arcane Power + Presence of Mind (instant Arcane Blast) + racial together; Arcane Power costs +30% mana, so open with full mana.
Arcane Blast to 3 stacks (182 + 500 + 819 mana), then spend the stacks with Frostbolt (+30% to it); with low mana spend at 2 stacks; Fire Blast spends them while moving.

Arcane Missiles whenever Missile Barrage is up (free, 2.5 s). Engine option: gs gives the missiles the Arcane Blast bonus, the client mask does not; with the client rule fire it at 0 stacks (right after the Frostbolt).
Clearcasting on a 3-stack Arcane Blast saves the most. Mana Ruby below ~80%, potion below ~50%, Evocation below 15%.
fire: Before the pull: Mage Armor. Open with Scorch until 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks (5 casts at 3/3).
Pyroblast the moment Heating Up has 3 stacks (1.5 s cast); never hard-cast a 6 s Pyroblast except pre-pull.
Fire Blast on cooldown (6 s with Wake of Fire 2/2) when mana allows; it is also the movement spell.
Re-Scorch when Fire Vulnerability has <= 5 s left.
Filler: Scorch (gs; fastest way to build Heating Up) or Fireball (fs, when mana >= 10%). Offer both.
Combustion on cooldown, best just before a 3-stack Pyroblast; it ends after 3 crits.
frost: Before the pull: Mage Armor (or Ice Armor if the dummy hits), Arcane Intellect, optional Ice Barrier.
Frostbolt (2.5 s) is the whole rotation; Winter's Chill reaches 5 stacks by itself (100% per hit at 5/5) and stays up.
Fingers of Frost proc: Ice Lance (x4, +50% crit), twice with 2 charges. A Frostbolt already casting when it procs keeps neither bonus nor charge (sim rule), so finish it, then Ice Lance.
Ice Lance unbuffed (~200) is the emergency moving spell only. Cold Snap/Ice Block/Ice Barrier are defensive.
arcaneFrost: Frostbolt filler; Ice Lance on Fingers of Frost; Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage (20% per Frostbolt). Arcane Blast is talented but gs never casts it.
frostfire: Experimental (MythicSim): Scorch to 5 Fire Vulnerability, Frostfire Bolt filler (both Ignite and 2.0x Ice Shards crits), Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up, Ice Lance only on Fingers of Frost if talented.

engineGaps.detail: Arcane Missiles: 5 missiles, each a projectile (20 yd/s) with its own hit and crit roll and its own proc chances; period fixed at channel start (1.0 s, or 0.5 s with Missile Barrage); cancelled by moving or casting; the channel holds Arcane Blast stacks and spends them at the end; no first tick at 0 s. Blizzard: 8 ground ticks, Arcane Concentration rolled on the cast. Evocation: regen x16 while channelling, cancellable.

Fire Vulnerability: +3% of THIS mage's Fire damage per stack (5, 30 s, refreshed per stack, 33/66/100% per Scorch). Winter's Chill: +2% crit per stack for this mage's Frostbolt and Ice Lance only (1 stack per talent point, 15 s). The existing per-school damage-taken debuffs apply to everyone and all spells.
Payload = 40% of the crit's final damage; unpaid ticks roll into the new payload; 2 ticks over 4 s; no crit, no modifiers, no Fire Power; one per mage; does not spend Combustion.

engineGaps.gap: Self-buff stacks that modify other spells
engineGaps.detail: Arcane Blast stacks (+10% to other spells, +175% own cost, spent by the next other damage cast, held by Missiles); Heating Up (-25% Pyroblast cast per stack, spent on Pyroblast completion); Combustion (+10% Fire crit per Fire hit, ends after 3 crits, cooldown starts at the end); Presence of Mind (next cast-time spell instant, cooldown starts on use); Clearcasting (one free damage spell, 1 s proc ICD); Missile Barrage (changes the next Missiles' period and cost); Fingers of Frost (2 charges, "treat as Frozen": +Shatter crit, Ice Lance x4, in-flight rule).
Cold Snap finishes the cooldown of all other Frost spells (Cone of Cold, Frost Nova, Ice Barrier, Ice Block). Single-target value is small; the mechanism is needed for the button to work.

engineGaps.gap: Costs as % of base mana with stacking multipliers
engineGaps.detail: Arcane Blast 15% of 1213 x (1 + 1.75 x stacks + 0.30 Arcane Power); Frost Channeling -15%; Clearcasting -100%; Missile Barrage -100% for Missiles.

Master of Elements refunds 10/20/30% of base cost on Fire/Frost crits (9 ms ICD). Casting regen is additive: Mage Armor 50% + Arcane Meditation 50% = 100%. Mana gems share one 2 min timer; potion separate.

Frostfire Bolt is Fire and Frost at once: lower of the two resistances, higher of the two spell-damage bonuses, both schools' talents (Fire Power, Piercing Ice, Critical Mass, Ice Shards 2.0x, Ignite, Winter's Chill, Heating Up, Missile Barrage, Fingers of Frost). Arcane Power/Instability skip its DoT.
Frostbolt, Ice Lance, Cone of Cold, Frost Nova and Blast Wave are hit-or-miss; others roll 0/25/50/75% partials (6% average vs +3). If the engine only rolls miss, apply x0.94 to non-binary spells.
Ice Shards (Frost and Frostfire) and Arcane Mind (Arcane) raise crits from 1.5x to 2.0x; Fire stays 1.5x.

engineGaps.gap: Procs that roll on projectile impact
engineGaps.detail: Missile Barrage, Winter's Chill, Fingers of Frost, Improved Scorch and Ignite roll when the hit lands, usually after the next cast has started; Fingers of Frost then skips the in-progress cast.

engineGaps.gap: Several DoTs per target from one caster
engineGaps.detail: Fireball DoT (refreshed by each Fireball), Pyroblast DoT, Frostfire Bolt DoT and Ignite can tick at once; all dynamic (no snapshot) except Ignite's payload.

Fire Blast 20 yd; Frostbolt, Scorch, Missiles, Arcane Blast, Ice Lance, Blizzard 30 yd; Fireball, Pyroblast, Frostfire Bolt 35 yd; Arcane Explosion, Frost Nova, Blast Wave 10 yd around you; Cone of Cold 10 yd cone.
Only if the dummy attacks: 1.0 s then -0.2 s per hit; Burning Soul, Improved Channeling, Ice Barrier protection; beta bugs #188 and #21.

foreverVsClassic: Spell, melee and ranged hit and crit from gear are shared (panel recap). Arcane Focus and Elemental Precision now give hit (+1%/point) instead of resist reduction.

Ignite, Improved Scorch (Fire Vulnerability) and Winter's Chill are personal: one Ignite per mage, Fire Vulnerability boosts only its mage, Winter's Chill only that mage's Frostbolt and Ice Lance (one stack per talent point). Ignite rolls over instead of munching and no longer double dips (24 Sep).

New: Arcane Blast (11-point talent, stacking buff for other spells), Missile Barrage (16-point), Arcane Geometry, Heating Up (Pyroblast cast reduction, renamed from Hot Streak 1 Oct, 20 s), Ice Lance (11-point), Fingers of Frost, and baseline Frostfire Bolt (level 40).

Arcane Mind gives Intellect and +100% Arcane crit damage; Ice Block is the Frost 16-point talent; Cold Snap is the 21-point talent with a 10 min cooldown (Blizzard: was 5); Arcane Power now needs Presence of Mind; Blast Wave no longer needs Pyroblast; Shatter no longer needs Improved Frost Nova; Magic Attunement is baseline.
Combustion: 3 crits (briefly 4 before 1 Oct). Wake of Fire replaces Improved Fire Blast (-2 s and a post-kill crit buff). Incineration covers Fire Blast, Scorch, Ice Lance and Arcane Blast.

Damage: Fireball 12 425-541 + 60 (Classic 596-760 + 76), Frostbolt 11 457-493 (515-555), Scorch 166-197 (237-280), Pyroblast 520-646 + 212, Missiles 209 per missile at 0.286 (230 at 0.24), Fire Blast 417-489. Low ranks lost their downranking coefficient penalty but much lower ranks now get less spell damage and fewer talent procs.
Mage Armor 50% casting regen (30%), Arcane Meditation 17/33/50% (5/10/15%), Arcane Intellect 1 hour, Improved Blizzard slow 40% (65%), shorter Cone of Cold slow, Permafrost +11/22/33%.

Blizzard and Flamestrike's burn are area triggers; Arcane Missiles checks line of sight once; Evocation, mana gems, Arcane Power, Presence of Mind unchanged in the client. Molten Armor, Icy Veins, Dragon's Breath and Water Elemental do not exist.

DoTs (Fireball, Pyroblast, Frostfire) are dynamic and can crit. Curse of the Elements covers all magic schools; Curse of Shadows removed; crit aura covers spells. World buffs do not work in raids. Wands no longer gain spell damage.
